questions.question: Why can a vector search alone miss information, and how can that be mitigated?
questions.reference: Vector (semantic) search can miss key facts needed to answer a question. It can be mitigated with hybrid search: also run a traditional full text search and combine its results with the chunks from the vector search, using scoring or reranking, before giving the text to the language model.

questions.question: What is the difference between sparse and dense vectors?
questions.reference: Sparse vectors encode the identity of a word, are as long as the dictionary and mostly zeros. Dense vectors encode meaning, are more compact and contain fewer zeros.

questions.question: Which extra steps can some RAG models add after retrieval to improve the output?

When may a team use a longer line limit than 79 characters, and what is the upper limit?
questions.reference: When the code is maintained exclusively or primarily by a team that can reach agreement, the limit may be raised up to 99 characters, as long as comments and docstrings are still wrapped at 72 characters.

questions.question: Should long lines be broken with backslashes or with parentheses?
questions.reference: Wrapping expressions in parentheses is preferred to using a backslash for line continuation, although backslashes may still be appropriate at times.
must_contain: in preference to using a backslash

questions.question: Into which groups should imports be arranged, and in what order?
questions.reference: 1. Standard library imports, 2. related third party imports, 3. local application or library specific imports.
